description: Read the live transcript — works during both recordings and live transcript sessions. Use 'since' to get new finalized lines after a cursor (line number) or time window (e.g., '5m', '30s'). Set include_current for one fresh, clearly provisional current-speech draft. Use 'status' mode to check if a session is active. Docs: https://useminutes.app/docs/mcp/tools#tool-read_live_transcript

include_current.description: If true, return finalized lines plus at most one fresh provisional current-speech draft and its replacement identity

relay_cursor.description: Transient relay cursor returned by a previous read. Reconnects without replaying already-seen transcript or nudge frames.

since.description: Line number (e.g., '42') or duration (e.g., '5m', '30s'). Omit to get all lines.

status_only.description: If true, return session status instead of transcript lines

name: read_live_transcript
